sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Communication Services / Broadcasting · Indonesia. PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk, through its subsidiaries, engages in the media, healthcare, aviation support services, digital products and services, and other businesses in Indonesia. The company's Media segment is involved in the free-to-air television broadcasting business through six television channels, as well as content, film and video production and distribution, and digital businesses.
